title: Spec 014 Final Work Map and Schema Classification Exact-head Readback

phases.objective: Recompute the effective Work Map and schema-classification registry on the exact candidate head, refresh only the bounded Spec 014 binding through a deterministic producer, reject stale state fail-closed, and emit secret-free structured evidence before T006 can close.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec Kit Work Map governance automation
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec 014 work-map-integration.json on an exact pull-request head
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The current 19-map and 16-domain effective registry, schema classification coverage, manifest fingerprint, decision sets, and readiness state agree exactly or the guard fails with a structured drift report.
steps: Load the canonical Work Map index, coverage matrix, integration policy, and schema-classification registry.
Recompute the effective registry fingerprint including the current classification-registry hash.
Require 19 Work Maps, 16 schema domains, zero unresolved objects, zero taxonomy-gap clusters, and 100 percent classification coverage.
Use the deterministic producer to refresh only registry binding fields and the T006 task state when exact drift is proven.
Compare the complete Work Map and domain decision sets with the effective registry.
Compare the manifest fingerprint, source hashes, counts, implementation readiness, and unresolved-dimension state with the current registry.
Write a bounded JSON and Markdown report even when drift is detected.
Publish the initial diagnostic and exact refreshed values inside the Spec evidence package.
Upload the structured report before enforcing the fail-closed result.
assertions: Registry fingerprint and source hashes are exact-head derived rather than copied from an old checkpoint.
All current Work Maps and schema domains have explicit Spec 014 decisions.
Schema classification is fail-closed with zero unresolved objects and no expired or ambiguous exception.
Implementation readiness has no blocking dimensions after all repository decisions are resolved.
The producer changes only work-map-integration.json and the T006 task line.
The permanent evidence records the structured diagnostic artifact and exact before/after registry values.
No repository mutation occurs during readback execution.
No Hostinger, SSH, credential, live database, migration Apply, Provider dispatch, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: This repository readback does not operate a live provider or database.
Any future Work Map, domain, source-hash, or schema-classification drift remains fail-closed through the exact-head guard.
No live canary is appropriate for a repository-governance readback.
This readback grants no deployment, main, or Production authority.
